_about: Literature ledger (docs/research/publication.md, rule 3). Every number the summary quotes from a paper comes from here. version_read: version of record (VoR), accepted manuscript (AM) or preprint. checked_vor: whether the value was compared with the version of record. Before any submission every entry must have checked_vor = true.

landesfeind2019_kappa_eq15_ec_emc.quantity: fit parameters p1..p6 of the ionic conductivity, Eq. 15, LiPF6 in EC:EMC (3:7 w:w), 0.1-3.0 M, -10 to +50 C; kappa in mS/cm, c in mol/L, T in K
landesfeind2019_kappa_eq15_ec_emc.source: J. Landesfeind, H. A. Gasteiger, J. Electrochem. Soc. 166, A3079 (2019)

landesfeind2019_tplus_eq20_ec_emc.quantity: fit parameters p1..p9 of the transference number, Eq. 20, LiPF6 in EC:EMC (3:7 w:w); c in mol/L, T in K
landesfeind2019_tplus_eq20_ec_emc.do_not_evaluate: The printed parameters have three significant digits and the polynomial cancels terms of size ~24 at 20 C (p3*T, p6*T^2), so rounding alone moves t+ by about +-0.4. Evaluated at 1 M, 293.15 K it gives 0.16, not the 0.22 the text reports. Quote the text values (landesfeind2019_tplus_1M_20C_ec_emc) instead.

landesfeind2019_tplus_1M_20C_ec_emc.quantity: transference number, 1 M LiPF6 in EC:EMC (3:7 w:w), 20 C: measured, and the value of the fit
landesfeind2019_tplus_1M_20C_ec_emc.location: text next to Eq. 20 ("0.16 (the fit suggests 0.22)")

lehnert2025_tplus_vol_ec_emc.quantity: transference number in the volume-averaged (VOL) frame, constant fit coefficient, LiPF6 in EC:EMC (3:7 w:w)
lehnert2025_tplus_vol_ec_emc.source: L. Lehnert et al., J. Electrochem. Soc. 172, 050523 (2025)

lehnert2025_tplus_com_sol_fit_ec_emc.quantity: linear fit t+ = t0 + t1*c (c in mol/L) of the MD transference number, LiPF6 in EC:EMC (3:7 w:w), centre-of-mass (COM) and solvent-velocity (SOL) frames

landesfeind2019_density_fit_ec_emc_3_7.quantity: electrolyte density fit rho = p1 + p2*c + p3*T in g/cm3, c in mol/L, T in K, LiPF6 in EC:EMC 3:7 w:w, 0-50 C, 0.1-3 M
landesfeind2019_density_fit_ec_emc_3_7.source: T. Landesfeind, H. A. Gasteiger, J. Electrochem. Soc. 166, A3079 (2019), SI
landesfeind2019_density_fit_ec_emc_3_7.location: SI Eq. S1, Table S1 (95 % bounds 5 %, 3 %, 22 %)

marcus2004_single_ion_volumes_pc_25C.quantity: standard partial molar volumes of single ions in propylene carbonate at 25 C, TATB/TPTB scale, cm3/mol, uncertainty +-2; and the salt value they derive from
marcus2004_single_ion_volumes_pc_25C.source: Y. Marcus, G. Hefter, Chem. Rev. 104, 3405 (2004)
marcus2004_single_ion_volumes_pc_25C.location: Table 15 (ions), Table 14 (LiPF6, 40 C, ref 41, unconfirmed), Table 40 (Vint), Eq. 29 (V(TP+) - V(TB-) = 2 +- 2)

lundgren2015_partial_molar_volumes_ec_de.quantity: partial molar volumes of LiPF6 and of the solvent, LiPF6 in EC:DEC (1:1 w:w), cm3/mol, at 10, 25, 40 C; constant in 0.5-1.5 M
lundgren2015_partial_molar_volumes_ec_de.source: H. Lundgren, M. Behm, G. Lindbergh, J. Electrochem. Soc. 162, A413 (2015)
lundgren2015_partial_molar_volumes_ec_de.version_read: VoR, read by a research subagent

lehnert2025_shell_fig_s10.quantity: Li+ coordination numbers within rs = 0.516 nm (first minimum of g_LiP, SI Table S7), 1 M LiPF6 in EC:EMC (3:7 w:w), 20 C, zeta = 0.75; carbonyl O of EC and EMC, and PF6- (P)
lehnert2025_shell_fig_s10.location: SI Fig. S10, read off the plot (about +-0.1)

olguin2016_table1.quantity: gas-phase binding energy of Li+ to one solvent molecule at the carbonyl O, kcal/mol, no counterpoise; DMC in the cis-cis conformer
olguin2016_table1.source: M. Olguin, O. Borodin, P. Ganesh, P. R. C. Kent, J. L. Allen, W. A. Henderson, Phys. Chem. Chem. Phys. 18, 164 (2016)

self2024_drs_free_ec.quantity: DRS amplitude of the free-EC relaxation, EC:EMC (3:7 w:w), 21 C: neat solvent and 1 M LiPF6
self2024_drs_free_ec.source: J. Self, N. T. Hahn, K. A. Persson, Energy Environ. Mater. 7, e12494 (2024), CC BY 4.0

caleman2012_ec_oplsaa.quantity: EC at 312.15 K: OPLS-AA simulation (density g/L, enthalpy of vaporization kJ/mol) and experiment
caleman2012_ec_oplsaa.source: C. Caleman et al., J. Chem. Theory Comput. 8, 61 (2012), SI (experimental values compiled from DIPPR)

lehnert2025_box_density.quantity: density of Lehnert's 1 M LiPF6 EC:EMC (3:7 w:w) box, 47 ion pairs, g/cm3 (used for the EC concentration of the DRS estimate)
lehnert2025_box_density.source: Lehnert et al. 2025, SI (box composition; docs/lehnert2025-si-notes.md)

iupac_atomic_weights.quantity: standard atomic weights, g/mol (conventional values), for molar masses of EC (C3H4O3) and LiPF6
